description: Codex: Orks (11e) GOADED INTO ACTION (Da Big Hunt, 1 CP, opponent's Shooting phase) through the real enemy_has_shot window and the engine's 11e surge move. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes ACTIVE, P2 Orks. Setup-only privileges: P2's detachment is flipped to Da Big Hunt and its stratagems reloaded; the Beast Snagga Boyz (engaged with the Allarus in the fixture) step 3" back so they are a legal target, and are marked riled up (so the D6 can be re-rolled). The Custodes player clicks the Allarus Custodians' token and declares their balistus grenade launchers at the Beast Snagga Boyz (phase actions the shooting panel sends), then resolves with the dock's Fast Roll button. Once the Allarus have shot and the Boyz have lost wounds, the enemy_has_shot window opens for PLAYER 2: GOADED INTO ACTION with an enabled Use button. A real click spends 1 CP and opens the reactive-move panel for a surge move: D6 rolled, the riled-up re-roll used through the panel's Re-roll button (only once), Auto-move places the unit (closest model straight at the closest enemy, the rest coherent behind it), the panel reports the move legal and Confirm move finishes it. Asserts the CP delta, the D6/re-roll bookkeeping, no model moved further than the roll, the unit ended closer to the surge target, and the phase free again.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Beast Snagga Boyz step 3" back from the Allarus (legal target) and are riled up
no enemy_targets_unit_shooting offer is under test; decline one if it appears
with this seed the phase's existing 'all remaining targets destroyed' check auto-completes the activation after the saves

steps.equals: GOADED INTO ACTION — Beast Snagga Boyz

steps.comment: surge move set up: D6 rolled, it is the move limit, the target is the closest enemy unit; remember the starting distance

steps.script:
var info = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().ork11e_reactive_move_info()
return not bool(info.reroll_available) and int(info.roll) >= 1 and int(info.roll) <= 6 and float(info.max_inches) == float(info.roll)

var info = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().ork11e_reactive_move_info()
return bool(info.valid) and float(info.moved_inches) > 0.0 and float(info.moved_inches) <= float(info.max_inches) + 0.05

steps.comment: the unit ended closer to the surge target than it started
